name: Zen Browser
summary: Zen is the best way to browse the web. Beautifully designed, privacy-focused, and packed with features. We care about your experience, not your data.

versions.release_notes:
Zen Stable Release

Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-130/

New Features
- Updated to Firefox 160.0.1
- The copy URL and copy URL as Markdown shortcuts now copy the URLs of all selected tabs when multiple tabs are selected.

Fixes
- Fixed boosts color tinting and controls not working. (#16586)
- Fixed closed browser and popup windows never being freed from memory, which made memory usage and pauses grow over time. (#16587)
- Switching spaces is now smooth when spaces use gradient themes, instead of being choppy. (#13029)
- Fixed tabs shown in a split view or behind a glance being unloaded when memory runs low. (#16624)
- Fixed Spaces Sync for spaces and pinned tabs assigned to the built-in containers (Personal, Work, Banking, Shopping) on profiles that don't have them. Missing containers are now created when needed. (#16614)
- Fixed the copy URL shortcut copying "about:blank" while a page is still loading. (#16510)
- Improved performance when opening new windows with mods installed. (#16674)
- Fixed thin lines in PDFs printing as thick black boxes on some printers on Windows.
- Fixed PDFs, web page graphics, and WebGL content appearing blank or broken on Macs with AMD graphics, such as black cells in Google Sheets.
- Fixed incorrect colors in WebGL and canvas content, such as games and Google Meet backgrounds, on some Linux systems using Wayland.
- Fixed links on some sites, such as the Google Store, taking a very long time to load.
- Fixed tabs crashing on some sites, most notably ChatGPT.
- Fixed WebTransport connections being unable to send datagrams after a site sent many in quick succession.
- Fixed trackpad and mouse swipes sometimes scrolling the page when a site had blocked scrolling.
- More bug fixes and improvements.

Changes
- The zoom level button is now hidden in the single toolbar layout. A toast shows the current zoom level when you change it instead.

Zen Stable Release

Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-125/

New Features
- Updated to Firefox 159.0.1
- Added pause context menu button for the downloads section
- The urlbar now has a bit of transparency for a more modern look.
- The Picture-in-Picture player now has a playback speed setting, with options ranging from 0.25x to 2.0x speed. The setting appears only when the player window is medium-sized or larger.
- Pages saved as PDF now make mathematical content (MathML) accessible to assistive technology such as screen readers.
- Websites that repeatedly ask to handle email (mailto:) and other links can now be blocked with a new “Never allow” button, and blocked sites can be managed in Settings.
- Zen now plays Matroska (MKV) files with FLAC, MP3, or PCM audio.
- WebGL content on macOS is now rendered using Apple's Metal graphics API, which can improve performance on some sites.

Fixes
- Improved performance for boosts color tinting.
- Fixed the first character typed into the address bar or search bar sometimes being lost when typing quickly right after clicking into it.
- Fixed Zen freezing for several seconds when signing in to intranet sites that use NTLM or Kerberos (Negotiate) authentication.
- Fixed double-tapping or long-pressing a word to select it, and tapping to place the cursor, not working near the cursor in text fields.
- Fixed links opened in the background from other apps on macOS, such as RSS readers, bringing Zen to the foreground.
- Fixed downloaded files on macOS sometimes opening in the wrong application instead of the default one set in Finder.
- Fixed simultaneous downloads on macOS never finishing when Zen is set to ask where to save files. Only the first file showed a save dialog.
- Restored meaningful filenames and the usual save workflow for PDFs opened in Preview from the macOS print dialog.
- More bug fixes and improvements.

Changes
- The address bar context menu now shows "Paste and Search" instead of "Paste and Go" when the copied text is a search term rather than a web address.

Zen Stable Release

Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-123/

New Features
- Updated to Firefox 159.0.1
- New grain options have been added to the theme picker. You can cycle through different grain effects by clicking on the circle inside the dial.

Fixes
- Fixed a command prompt window briefly appearing on Windows when Zen restarts to apply an update.
- Fixed passkey sign-in failing on websites that share passkeys across related sites, such as Facebook and Instagram.
- Fixed crashes on Windows that could occur with some antivirus or other security software installed, in some cases also leaving WebGL disabled.
- Fixed red and blue colors appearing swapped on some websites that use WebGL on Linux, including video call background effects.
- More bug fixes and improvements.

Changes
- On macOS, icons on the UI will now start using SF Symbols.
- The 'About Zen' window has been redesigned.
- 'My Review Request' option for Pull Requests live folder now searches for 'user-review-requested:@me' instead of 'review-requested:@me'

Zen Stable Release

Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-118/

New Features
- Updated to Firefox 159.0
- You can now import Spaces and Profiles from Arc and Dia.
- Boosts gets a nice upgrade! THey can now be shared with others and they get an overall quality improvement.
- Holding 'ctrl' (or 'cmd' on macOS) while hovering over the new tab button will now give the option to 'Paste & Search'.
- You can now remove/add tabs from the library.
- An indicator will now show when a tab is not visible.

Fixes
- Fixed an issue where expanded glance tabs would not appear on the right Space. (#16080)
- Fixed the file upload dialog opening in the last folder a file was saved to, such as Downloads, instead of the folder last used for uploads.
- Fixed memory usage growing rapidly when sites such as the Zoom web app were left open in a minimized window.
- Fixed some videos displaying incorrectly on Windows when NVIDIA RTX Video HDR is enabled.
- Fixed bookmarks not being imported from Google Chrome profiles that are signed in to a Google account.
- Fixed the Replace button in Apple Writing Tools on macOS inserting the clipboard contents instead of the rewritten text on some sites.
- Fixed long drop-down lists on web pages sometimes showing blank space in place of the last options until the list was scrolled.
- Fixed some sites, such as Slack, failing to load instead of falling back to HTTP/2 when the site rejected an HTTP/3 request.
- Fixed Zen using excessive memory on Linux with AMD graphics when viewing map or place results on sites such as ChatGPT.
- Fixed quick gamepad button presses sometimes being missed in web games on macOS.
- Fixed tabs sometimes detaching into a new window when clicked on Linux with Wayland.
- Fixed menus and panels fading in on Windows and Linux when animation effects are turned off in the operating system.
- More bug fixes and improvements.

Changes
- Zen's keyboard shortcuts have been improved and moved to about:keyboard.
- Space Routing settings have been moved to the Library
- On the site center, the reader mode button has been moved next to the 'Secure' button and shown only if available.
- Web addresses written in the Javanese, Balinese, Canadian Aboriginal Syllabics, and N'Ko scripts are now displayed in their own script instead of as encoded "xn--" text.

Zen Stable Release

Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-111/

New Features
- Updated to Firefox 158.0.1
- Boosts now have a 'focus' feature, allowing you to concentrate on a specific part of the website.
- Windows builds now run with CSIR PGO, improving performance and startup times. All other platforms also have performance improvements.

Fixes
- Mozilla blocked compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates via OneCRL on October 17th. The blocks were distributed to clients via Remote Settings the same day. This update contains the updated OneCRL block list, ensuring clients will block the compromised certificates even if RemoteSettings is disabled by policy or otherwise unavailable in the user's network environment. (Learn More)
- Fixed the sidebar hiding when the mouse is still over it. (#15995)
- Fixed devtools not appearing on glance tabs. (#15261)
- Boosts zap bar will now push the web contents up when activated. (#13972)
- Fixed sidebar scroll being reset when entering fullscreen. (#14389)
- Fixed multiple windows launching on startup on Linux and Windows. (#12140)
- Fixed a crash on Windows when printing or saving a page as PDF while a screen reader or other assistive technology was running.
- Fixed an issue where Zen was opening windows on the wrong monitor in multi-monitor setups on Linux.
- Fixed multiple media bars appearing when 2 or more tabs are using WebRTC.
- Fixed an issue where files dragged into Firefox from other applications were not dropped onto the page on macOS.
- External links will now be routed through the Space Routing feature on startup
- More bug fixes and improvements.

Zen Stable Release

Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2026-106

New Features
- Updated Firefox to 158.0
- Added a --space <id|name> option to the command line interface.
- Library will now show a 'Open in Folder' option and download speed when hovering over the toolbar icon.
- Zen now creates more accessible PDFs when saving a page as PDF, and when printing on Linux and macOS. This also fixes a variety of PDF rendering issues, such as missing math symbols.

Fixes
- Fixed various animation, urlbar and UI performance issues.
- Fixed Library media tab requesting onedrive to download all files from cloud. (#15888)
- Fixed unwanted label next to the search icon in urlbar. (#14856)
- Fixed Avahi access so CUPS printers are listed in flatpak sandbox. (#9651)
- Fixed various memory leak issues. (#15954)
- Fixed a crash that could occur while Zen loaded website icons (favicons).
- Fixed menus such as List all tabs, Settings, etc being hard to read with a Windows High Contrast theme. Menu background and text colors now follow the Background and Text colors chosen for a custom contrast theme in Windows Settings.
- Other bug fixes and improvements.

Changes
- Space routing regex will now match URLs as case-insensitive.
- Library's widget hover list will now only display recently downloaded files.
- Zen no longer rounds scroll positions to whole screen pixels. Scrolling is now smoother and more precise, especially on high-resolution displays or when a page is zoomed.

Zen Stable Release

New Features
- Added an 'open library' command to the command palette.
- You can now right-click the media tab in the Library to disable it.

Fixes
- Changed session backup file names to use local dates (#15806)
- Fixed the library getting stuck after opening and closing it quickly (#15833)
- Fixed blocked/unsafe downloads not having the choice to be opened or saved. (#15809)
- Fixed moving multiple tabs to new window irrecoverably loses unloaded tabs. (#15810)
- Fixed the sidebar having too much minimum width when they are aligned to the right. (#15794)
- Fixed HEIC media being listed in the media tab but do not render correctly. (#15778)
- Fixed space-assigned bookmarks not being saved anymore. (#12721)
- Fixed a memory leak issue on startup.
- Other bug fixes and improvements.

Zen Stable Release

Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-104/

New Features
- Updated to Firefox 157.0.1
- Added an option in the Library to filter closed tabs instead of history entries.
- A keyboard shortcut (opt/alt + shift + L) has been added to quickly open the Library.
- 'Clear all downloads' and 'Clear history' options have been added to the Library by right clicking on the respective section tabs.

Fixes
- Fixed transparent sidebars having low opacity.
- Fixed downloads failing on macOS when Firefox is set to ask where to save files but doesn't have permission to access the Downloads folder.
- Other bug fixes and improvements.

Zen Stable Release
Introducing Library! A better place to organize and access your history, media, downloads, spaces and more.

Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-97/

New Features
- Introducing Library! A better place to organize and access your history, media, downloads, spaces and more.
- You can now resize the sidebar even when its hidden. If the sidebar is resized too small, it will automatically hide itself.
- Updated to Firefox 157.0
- WebRTC video calls can now use hardware AV1 decoding on devices that support it, instead of always decoding AV1 video in software.

Fixes
- Significant performance improvements on startups/new windows when there are lots of tabs open.
- Certain icon animations like the boost indicator or musical notes on the sidebar are now more performant. (#15299)
- Fixed status panel and glance controls not using the correct theme colors. (#15280)
- Fixed some HDR videos encoded in 8-bit color formats looking dull and gray on Windows instead of displaying in HDR.
- Improved audio and video synchronization when repeatedly changing the playback speed of videos, for example on YouTube.
- Fixed an issue on Windows where making a video full screen would leave the Windows taskbar showing over the video.

Changes
- When a link gets routed to a specific space, it will prioritize the window that has that space open.
- Some elements like the sidebar and the command bar now appear with blur effects.
- On MacOS, buttons at the bottom of the sidebar now appear larger.
- Swiping to the right on the last space will now try to create a new space.
- When the sidebar is at the right, the buttons at the bottom are now reversed.

Zen Stable Release

New Features
- Updated to Firefox 156.0.1
- The command bar now allows you to search through tabs and folders more efficiently.

Fixes
- Fixed Zen leaking system handles on Windows as content processes were started and stopped.
- Fixed context menu actions on the urlbar not working. (#15437)
- Fixed overflow-extension order in single toolbar mode. (#15419)
- Fixed not being able to install add-ons while in compact mode. (#15445)
- Fixed Zen windows on macOS 27 immediately returning to maximized after being restored by double-clicking the title bar.
- Other bug fixes and improvements.

Zen Stable Release

Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-90/

New Features
- Updated to Firefox 156.0
- Zen on macOS can now be set to open automatically when the computer starts up, from the Startup section of Settings.
- Added the following actions to the command bar: 'Expand current view', 'New space', 'Reopen closed tab', 'Duplicate tab', 'Reset pinned tab'.

Fixes
- Fixed high-sample-rate FLAC audio in MP4 failing to play on certain video sites.
- Fixed subtitles not appearing in the Picture-in-Picture window when they are turned on in the video player after the window has already opened.
- Fixed the find bar becoming permanently unavailable in a tab after reversing the panes in Split View.
- Fixed some sites failing to load when DNS over HTTPS is enabled and the site does not support HTTPS.
- Fixed an issue on Windows where Zen could block an auto-hiding taskbar from showing.
- Fixed the sidebar not hiding if the urlbar is open when compact mode is enabled. (#13196)
- Fixed an issue where cross-space tab routing would freeze the browser under certain conditions. (#14171)
- Fixed cross-device sync losing certain tabs if they are created too quickly (#15380)
- Fixed certain issues related to live folders appearing as active even when they are no tabs showing in them.
- Other bug fixes and improvements.

Changes
- Zen's built-in PDF viewer now starts up to 45% faster.
- Improved memory and CPU usage when Zen displays large JPEG images scaled down to fit a page.
- On Windows devices with ARM64 processors, WebRTC video calls may now use hardware H264 decoding instead of falling back to software.
- Live Folders will now ignore archived issues and pull requests.
- Improved the look and feel of drag-and-drop interactions for tabs. Specially on MacOS, where the drag-and-drop behavior is now done natively.
- Folders will now fully-expand if all tabs within them are visible. Folder animations has also been improved for smoother transitions.

Zen Stable Release

New Features
- You now have the option to sync normal tabs across devices along with your Spaces, Folders, and other data. This can be enabled in Settings > Sync > Sync your Spaces across devices.
- You can now share Spaces, folders and split views to other Zen users and non-Zen users via a shareable link. This can be found in the context menu of a Space, folder or split view.

Fixes
- Noticeably improved performance and battery usage while scrolling, and playing videos.
- Other bug fixes and improvements.

Zen Stable Release

Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-82/

New Features
- Updated to Freifox 155.0 and 155.0.1
- By using your Mozilla account, you can now sync your Spaces, Folders, Tabs, and much more between devices! This can be enabled in Settings > Sync > Sync your Spaces across devices.
- The chrome UI now has a better look and feel, implementing squircles and other design elements to make it more visually appealing.
- A new on-boarding experience has been added to help new users get started with the browser and its features.
- Creating a new Space is now faster and requires less animation wait time, making the process more efficient.
- Containers can now be reordered in Settings, and the new order is used wherever containers are listed.

Fixes
- Fixed live folders for GitHub issues not working with the new GitHub UI
- Fixed Zen preventing Linux systems from going to sleep after a long browsing session.
- Fixed arrow-key and Page Up/Down scrolling not working on some pages with embedded content from other sites.
- Fixed live audio streams such as internet radio stopping when playing in the background.
- Other bug fixes and improvements.

Changes
- Font size has been increased for the sidebar text, making it easier to read and navigate through tabs and spaces.
- Zen now uses firefox-portal-detection.com instead of detectportal.firefox.com to detect captive portals and check network connectivity, so network allowlists referencing the old domain need updating.
- PDFs smaller than the paper size can now be enlarged to fill the sheet when printing, by setting the scale above 100%.

New Features

Fixes

Zen Stable Release

Security

New Features

- Sites can now be exempted from having their cookies and site data cleared on shutdown without also being exempted from tracking protection and other cookie restrictions.
- The full-page Translations feature now translates <iframe> content.

Fixes

- Fix multiple glance tabs when joining tabs (#14975)

- Fixed an issue on Windows where an auto-hiding taskbar would not appear until the Zen window had been minimized and restored after launch.
- Fixed an issue where the Windows taskbar would appear in front of a full screen Picture-in-Picture window.
- Fixed PDF documents not being scaled correctly in print preview when the Fit to Page Width option is used.
- Other bug fixes and improvements.

Known Issues
- Following recent changes to Zen's password storage, some users may experience slower performance when Zen accesses saved passwords. Users with a Primary Password enabled may also see unexpected password prompts, such as when starting Zen or opening certain content.

Zen Stable Release
This release includes a major new feature called Boosts! Boosts allow you to customize the look and feel of any website to your liking. To start boosting, click the site's control icon in the urlbar and click the new 'Boost' button.

Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-46/

New Features
- Updated to Firefox 151.0 and 151.0.1
- Boosts are now in Zen! This allows you to tint colors, customize fonts and styles, zap elements and enable automatic dark mode on any website!
- Overflowing web extensions will now appear below the urlbar instead of being added back into the site control panel. This only happens in single-sidebar mode.
- Zen now strengthens protection against fingerprinting in Standard Enhanced Tracking Protection, making it harder for websites to track you across sites by limiting the amount of information revealed about your device and browser. This reduces the number of users uniquely identifiable by common fingerprinting techniques by an average of ~14%, and by ~49% on macOS.
- You can now merge multiple PDFs directly in Zen PDF. Combine separate PDF files into a single document without ever leaving Zen or relying on third-party tools.

Fixes
- Fixed a bug where the url would be cut off when the urlbar was too small. (#13719)
- Fixed 'go back to original url' button on pinned tabs showing up even when the url was not modified. (#12949)
- Added better support for cyclic workspace switching
- Fixed video controls going under the screen when in fullscreen mode. (#10594)
- Fixed closing a split view in one window selecting it on other windows. (#13761)

Changes
- Geolocation on Windows now respects the user's Windows location permission setting, instead of overriding it, when the user grants location permission to a page. Firefox will ask users to enable the Windows permission if it is needed.
